# CatppuccinRGB565

> Catppuccin color palette (all 4 flavors: Mocha, Macchiato, Frappé, Latte; all 26 colors) pre-converted to RGB565 for Arduino, ESP32, TFT, and OLED display libraries (TFT_eSPI, Adafruit_GFX, LovyanGFX).

CatppuccinRGB565 is a lightweight, zero-overhead C++ color palette library for embedded displays. All 26 official Catppuccin colors are provided as compile-time `constexpr uint16_t` constants and dynamic `Palette` structs in big-endian RGB565 format (5 bits red, 6 bits green, 5 bits blue).

## Quick Start

### Installation (PlatformIO)
Add to your `platformio.ini`:
```ini
lib_deps =
    https://github.com/nicholaswilde/catppuccin-rgb565.git
```

### Basic Usage (Compile-time Constants)
```cpp
#include <CatppuccinRGB565.h>

// Use compile-time constants from Catppuccin::<Flavor>::<color>
tft.fillScreen(Catppuccin::Mocha::base);
tft.setTextColor(Catppuccin::Mocha::text, Catppuccin::Mocha::base);
tft.fillRect(10, 10, 50, 30, Catppuccin::Mocha::mauve);
```

### Runtime Flavor Selection
```cpp
#include <CatppuccinRGB565.h>

void applyTheme(Catppuccin::Flavor flavor) {
    const Catppuccin::Palette& palette = Catppuccin::getPalette(flavor);
    tft.fillScreen(palette.base);
    tft.setTextColor(palette.text, palette.base);
}
```

## Key Files & Resources

- [CatppuccinRGB565.h](src/CatppuccinRGB565.h): Primary header defining all 4 namespaces (`Mocha`, `Macchiato`, `Frappe`, `Latte`), `Flavor` enum, `Palette` struct, and `getPalette()`.
- [CatppuccinRGB565.cpp](src/CatppuccinRGB565.cpp): Implementation of runtime palette lookups.
- [BasicUsage Example](examples/BasicUsage/BasicUsage.ino): Minimal TFT_eSPI setup with compile-time palette constants.
- [RuntimeFlavor Example](examples/RuntimeFlavor/RuntimeFlavor.ino): Dynamic theme switching with `Catppuccin::getPalette(flavor)`.
- [CydColorPalette Example](examples/CydColorPalette/CydColorPalette.ino): Complete ESP32 Cheap Yellow Display (CYD) color swatch application.
- [Unit Tests](tests/test_catppuccin/test_catppuccin.cpp): Host-native Unity unit test suite (`pio test -e native`).

## Flavors & Colors Available

Each flavor namespace (`Catppuccin::Mocha`, `Catppuccin::Macchiato`, `Catppuccin::Frappe`, `Catppuccin::Latte`) contains 26 `constexpr uint16_t` colors:
- **Accents**: `rosewater`, `flamingo`, `pink`, `mauve`, `red`, `maroon`, `peach`, `yellow`, `green`, `teal`, `sky`, `sapphire`, `blue`, `lavender`
- **Text & Foreground**: `text`, `subtext1`, `subtext0`
- **UI Surfaces**: `overlay2`, `overlay1`, `overlay0`, `surface2`, `surface1`, `surface0`
- **Backgrounds**: `base`, `mantle`, `crust`

## Macros & Utilities

- `CATP_SWAP(color)` / `CATP_SWAP16(color)`: Byte-swap 16-bit RGB565 values for display drivers requiring reversed endianness (e.g. certain SPI/DMA modes).
